tool.name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B
tool.summary: Dense 32B reasoning model distilled from DeepSeek-R1 onto Qwen2.5-32B, delivering top-tier mathematical and coding logic on consumer hardware.
tool.architecture: Qwen2.5-32B backbone fine-tuned on 800k DeepSeek-R1 reasoning trajectories.
tool.usage:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B", device_map="auto")
tool.limitations: Higher resource consumption than 8B models; requires ~20GB VRAM with 4-bit quantization.
